results.description:
Join over 2,000,000 users! Break free from adult content and regain control of your life. QUITTR is the #1 recovery app, designed to help you regain control and live with purpose. Whether you’re looking to cut down or quit entirely, QUITTR’s neuroscience-backed system helps you reshape your relationship with adult content, dopamine and more.


With real-time progress tracking, an encouraging community, and a full suite of tools—including meditations, interactive challenges, and more—you have everything you need to take charge of your habits. Reset your brain. Reset your life.


**WHY MILLIONS TRUST QUITTR**


REWIRE YOUR MIND

Built on extensive research in addiction science, our innovative brain-rewiring system guides you step by step to regain control. Transform your mind into your greatest asset.


MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT

Engaging daily exercises help replace temptation with motivation and a fresh perspective. Stop craving, start thriving.


TRACK YOUR PROGRESS

Monitor your improvements in relationships, mental clarity, and overall well-being with our real-time progress tracker. Don’t just notice the difference—measure it.


WATCH YOUR LIFE TREE GROW

Your personal “Life Tree” evolves with you. Every positive choice you make nurtures it, helping it flourish over time. See your growth reflected back at you.


A COMMUNITY THAT CARES

QUITTR is home to a thriving self-improvement network. Share success stories, stay accountable, and compete in healthy challenges alongside like-minded individuals.


ACHIEVE TRUE SATISFACTION

Whether you’re on day one or year one, every milestone strengthens your self-control and discipline. Unlock your full potential.


POWERFUL RECOVERY TOOLS

Advanced filtering technology, AI-powered temptation blockers, and an arsenal of self-improvement tools—all designed to help you break free and build a better life.


LEVEL UP YOUR FUTURE

Rebooting your brain unlocks significant mental and physical benefits. Begin today and transform your life permanently.


**REAL STORIES FROM THE QUITTR COMMUNITY**

"Now I feel stable, focused, and confident. Instead of facing massive roadblocks, I see small hurdles that I can step over with ease."


"I feel like a whole new person. I'm more engaged in social settings, sharp at work, and fully present. After years of struggling, I finally feel like myself again."


"The clarity and relief from depression were immediate. I used to think something was fundamentally wrong with me—now I know I just needed to break free. That realization was life-changing."


"Confidence. Walking down the street, I no longer feel self-conscious. I can talk to anyone without fear or hesitation. I’m not arrogant—I just finally see myself as equal to everyone around me. My social anxiety is gone."


SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION*


A QUITTR SUBSCRIPTION is required to use and enjoy full access to features and content. If you choose a QUITTR subscription, payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.


The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. From iTunes Account settings you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your trial ends, the remaining free trial period will be forfeited when your purchase is confirmed.

**DISCLAIMER: Seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app for medical decisions.**
